sourceOfTruth: Current main branch published inventories and recorded editorial decisions; derived coverage index only. No external photo scraping, editor approval, or app asset changes.
boundaries: 2026 365-day annual artwork census is a proposal/release-readiness inventory, not proof that 134 images render in the public app.
Class I selected titles may still lack an original file, date approval in all older snapshots, rights, or mobile crop acceptance; do not treat a 'frozen' title alone as release.
Class IV and 34 Class III contextual proposals are not the same as 105 independently approved date-specific paintings.
Prayer PUBLISHED_EXACT_PHOTO and PROTECTED_EXISTING_COVER counts represent canonical slots, not 56 unique painting/photo files.
Approved exact Prayer slots are not blank editorial slots and should not be sent to a fresh owner-review sweep.
Prior image/photo decisions of 25 approve and 35 reject from 60 concern exact museum source/photos, not automatic Calendar feast/date approvals.
Historical accepted/rejected artwork IDs, published covers, Rosary art and previously selected saints are immutable unless explicitly changed by owner.
Research candidate artworks from 989 title groups are lexical leads, not vetted subjects or approved date placements.
Do not trigger new image acquisition, contact museums, pay fees, import Commons automatically, or deploy public app from this index.
